tools.name: find_european_alternatives
tools.description: European software that replaces a non-European product ("Slack", "Google Analytics", "HubSpot"), in Europe Instead's ranking order. Each tool gives an origin score (how European the company is, 0 to 100) and an exposure level (1 to 5, who can reach the customer's data), both from sourced facts. Cite

tools.name: search_european_tools
tools.description: European software tools by name or by category ("crm", "web analytics"), with optional filters on exposure level, country and open source. Needs a query or a category.

tools.name: get_tool_details
tools.description: One European tool in full: the facts behind its origin score and exposure level, each with its source URL, quoted passage and check date, plus its subprocessors and features.

tools.name: list_replaced_products
tools.description: The non-European products that have European alternatives here, with how many, most first. At most 50; filter with a query.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Software categories with how many European tools each has, most first. At most 50; filter with a query.
